messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — RC cut tonight at 22:00 PT. Can folks confirm changelog entries are added and pass the linter? Run `./scripts/changelog-lint` locally or rely on the GH action.

Sam: On it. I still need an entry for #4821 (model routing fix). Who's adding that one?

Igor: I can add a short note. Quick q: should we normalize 'component' values? I keep seeing both 'runtime' and 'serving-runtime' in recent PRs.

Maya: Use the release template (exact keys matter for the linter). Example: 
```
- component: serving-runtime
  description: Fix incorrect KV cache eviction causing OOMs under high concurrency
  pr: #4821
  author: @Igor
```
Keep it one bullet per change, include PR/issue link, and a 1-line description.

Jen: FYI the changelog-lint GH action will fail if 'component' is not one of: serving-runtime, console, dedicated, private, infra, docs, deps. If you hit that, change the key to the approved set.

Sam: Added the #4821 entry and pushed to feature/rc-prepare. PTAL @Igor @Jen :thumbsup:

Igor: Left a tiny wording nit. Also note: the version bump lives in `build/release/version.txt` and needs a matching tag. I can do the bump after entries are merged unless someone else wants it.

Luke: @Maya do we want any backports to `release-1.8.x`? There's a small perf regression fix that really should be in the patch.

Maya: Yes — backport for perf-regression (#4790) approved. @Sam please open a PR against `release-1.8.x` and add `backport: yes` in the changelog bullet so release tooling picks it up.

release-bot: Deploy check: changelog GH actions status: 3/4 successful, 1 failing (changelog-lint).

Jen: I can fix the lint error now — looks like a YAML spacing issue in docs/CHANGELOG/2026-03-17.md. Pushing tiny formatting change.

Sam: Merged all entries and Jen's fix. @release-bot can you re-run the checks?

release-bot: Re-run queued. Results: 4/4 passing. All changelog checks green. :rocket:

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll cut rc/v1.9.0-rc1 at 22:00 PT and push the tag + release notes. If anything urgent pops up, ping me in this thread or DM. :v:
